heuristics: Standard NFS smoothness (Canfield-Erdos-Pomerance) and virtual-logarithm linear-algebra heuristics for SexTNFS in F_{p^12}.
Published SexTNFS cost estimate for BLS12-381 of about 2^126 elementary operations (Guillevic, PKC 2020, following Barbulescu-Duquesne 2019), with unknown o(1).
At most 2^8 scalar instructions per elementary sieve or linear-algebra operation.
limitations: The estimator output is not a proved upper bound for this field.
Shared field precomputation is charged in full to one cold instance.
